- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥ 0.7) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 5–10% for next 3–5 days.  
- After a sharp price spike (≥ 10% from prior peak), model often overshoots; cap forecast at +5% above peak for next 3 days.  
- If sentiment is consistently negative (≤ -0.5) over 5+ days, model underestimates; add 3–7% to forecast for next 5 days.  
- Model frequently lags 1–3 days behind true trend; adjust forecast to align with 2-day moving average of true values if sentiment is neutral or trending.  
- When true outcome shows mean reversion (e.g., 2–3 consecutive days below 80), model often holds high; reduce forecast by 5–10% for next 3 days.  
- If sentiment shifts from negative to positive within 2 days, model often fails to catch momentum; increase forecast by 3–8% for next 3 days.
